It is submitted by the learned counsel for the Informant that in the meanwhile the Informant Kutartha Dalei who was representing the company and set the law into motion has left the company and accordingly, the vakalatnama is being filed on behalf of the Cluster Manager of the Finance Company.
2.
Learned counsel Mr. A.K. Nayak & associates have entered appearance on behalf of the Cluster Manager of the Finance Company.
The vakalatnama is taken on record.
Registry is requested to reflect the name of Mr. A.K. Nayak & associates in the file, cause list as well as Web Portal of this Court.

3. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners, learned counsel for the State and learned counsel for the Cluster Manager of the Finance Company.
4.

The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with G.R. Case No.1299 of 2023 pending on the file of learned S.D.J.M., Jagatsinghpur arising out of Biridi P.S. Case No.232 of 2023 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 409/420 of IPC.
5.

During the course of hearing, learned counsels for the Petitioner as well as learned counsel representing the finance company submit that they will explore the possibility of settlement of the matter through ADR by way of Mediation.
